claims.assertion: Athena describes druids as sages, healers and record-keepers bridging physical and spirit worlds through herbal medicine, history and metaphysics.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She presents this as her own description.

claims.assertion: Athena says the dead carry beliefs into an etheric world mirroring life; some spirits can interact with living people when frequencies align.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She says this varies by individual.

claims.assertion: Athena says Arthur and Merlin stories combine historical figures and saga material with likely fictional additions; she places them near the first Crusades.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
